title: Mud, Then Baths
lines: Sal and Lin have big dogs, Bud and Tug.
They let them run up the hill.
Both dogs dig a pit. Mud is on them.
Sal fills a tub and Lin gets a rag.
Lin calls the dogs, and they run off!
"They do not want baths," said Lin.
Then Sal sits and taps the wet tub.
Bud hops in the tub. Then Tug hops in.
"They do want baths!" said Sal. "Look at them!"

questions.ask: How do the dogs get mud on them?
questions.listenFor: They dig a pit up on the hill. Line three says it - have your child find the word dig.

questions.ask: Calling the dogs did not work. What does Sal do next?
questions.listenFor: She sits down and taps the wet tub. Line eight says it. If they say "she got them in," ask how.

questions.ask: Why do you think the dogs got in when Sal stopped calling? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any sensible idea works. You want a reason of their own, like "they did not want to be told."
